tracking.label: Shipment tracking
tracking.description: Add a carrier and tracking number to orders you ship yourself.

refunds.label: Flexible refunds
refunds.description: Refund selected items or a whole order from Estori. Your Stripe balance must cover the refund.

sellerEmails.label: New order email alerts

Choose another supported language and start a translation using AI credits.

faq.question: Which plans include store translations?
faq.answer: Store translations are included with Pro and Premium. Automatic translation uses AI credits from your account.

faq.question: Are automatic translations free?
faq.answer: Automatic translation uses AI credits from your account. Reviewing and saving your own edits does not run the translation AI.

faq.question: Does this rewrite my store files?
faq.answer: No. Translations are stored separately and applied when shoppers view your store.

catalog.availabilityAnswer: Yes. Every plan can browse catalog products and add them to a store. Products, prices and shipping options depend on the current catalog.
catalog.pickProducts: Choose products from the supplier catalog.

payments.availabilityAnswer: Yes. Live stores can accept card payments through Stripe after you complete payment setup and publish your store. Preview checkouts stay in test mode.

payments.communitiesAnswer: Paid communities are in early access. Request access to discuss your setup.
payments.payoutsBenefit: Receive bank payouts weekly on Monday by default. Pro and Premium let you choose daily, weekly or monthly payouts. Your account costs {stripeFees}.
payments.stripeLimitNote: Stripe documents a general USD technical maximum of $999,999.99 per payment. Card networks may impose lower limits. Estori’s order and weekly selling safeguards above also apply.
